## Summary

Joshua Adela is a full stack engineer with {{ site.years_experience }}+ years of experience across backend and frontend
development. His core is Ruby on Rails, where he builds scalable, maintainable applications, and Angular and
Bootstrap on the frontend. He owns data layers with PostgreSQL, MySQL and Redis.

His current work is AI-native. He designs n8n workflows that automate repetitive processes by connecting tools,
APIs and AI steps, and he uses Claude and Claude Code daily for root-cause investigations, bug fixes, code audits,
automations and new feature development, applying senior engineering judgment to review AI output.

## What he does

- Workflow automation: n8n workflows that connect tools, APIs and AI steps to remove manual work.
- AI-native engineering: Claude / Claude Code for investigations, bug fixes, code audits and feature development.
- Scalable backends: Ruby on Rails applications, APIs, background jobs, PostgreSQL / MySQL / Redis.
- Intuitive interfaces: Angular and Bootstrap frontends.
